Anatomy and Physiology 
of the Cardiovascular System
Th e role of the cardiovascular system is to regulate blood 
ﬂ ow to the tissues in order to deliver oxygenated blood and 
nutrients as well as to retrieve waste products from cellular 
metabolism. Other major functions include thermoregulation,
hormone transport, maintenance of ﬂ uid volume, regulation of 
pH (to control acidosis and alkalosis), and gas exchange. Th e
